comment: Curated weapon-effect overrides (docs/architecture/weapon-effects.md 3.2), merged by tools/effects/weapon_effects_table.py into <game>/x3m/weapon_effects.json. by_id applies to any TBullets table carrying the SS_BULLET_* id; by_table[<decoded TBullets sha256 prefix>] applies to that exact table only and wins. Fields: style (tracer|slug|orb|wave|beam), tint ([r, g, b] linear 0..1), calibre (0..1). Users edit nothing; an unknown mod gets the classifier.
